### The Army of the Lord
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/army-lord
Passage: Joel 2:1-11
Points:
- Ancient Judah took God's favor for granted, wrongly believing Jerusalem was immune to judgment.
- Joel served as a spiritual sentry sounding the alarm that the Lord Himself led the approaching army.
- The devastating locust swarm functions as a type and foretaste of the ultimate Day of the Lord.
- Natural calamities remind humanity of impending cosmic judgment and the urgency of repentance.
- Divine warnings of wrath are meant to turn people from sin and motivate believers to share the gospel.

### He's Coming Again!
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-dec-31-2009-11624355.html
Passage: Joel 2:1
Points:
- Packing away seasonal decorations serves as a reminder that Christ will return.
- While Jesus first arrived as a baby in a manger, He will return as a reigning King.
- Joel's warning that the Day of the Lord is near reminds believers that His return is closer every day.
- Believers can eagerly anticipate the eternal peace and renewal promised upon His return.
- Waiting for His coming calls Christians to celebrate Christ daily and fulfill God's purpose on earth.
